events.title: Demo Available Now
events.summary: The Spiritura Demo is now live on Steam.Step into a hand-drawn world where survival, exploration, and story intertwine. Gather resources, build your shelter, meet wandering villagers, and uncover the first chapter of a much larger journey.This demo offers 2–4 hours of gameplay, with a glimpse into the systems and world that will continue to expand.If you enjoy sandbox adventures with a sense of discovery, give it a try and consider adding Spiritura to your wishlist!

events.title: Spiritura Demo: Join the PvE Survival Crafting Fest 2026
events.summary: Spiritura Demo Planned for August 31stA Solo-Dev Journey Four Years in the MakingThe world of Spiritura is more than just a sandbox—it is a hand-drawn sanctuary built on hundreds of iterations and a deep passion for systemic gameplay. After a long journey of development, I am thrilled to announce that the first playable demo will be available starting August 31st, during the Steam PvE Survival Crafting Fest.What to Expect in the Demo:First Biome Exploration: Navigate the opening biomes of a tier
